project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is TJ RIDGE. The article refers to the project as the 'TJ Property' in the sentence: 'Fabled Copper Corp. ("Fabled Copper" or the "Company") (CSE:FABL)(FSE:XZ7) is pleased to announce that it has entered into letter of intent dated December 16, 2022 (the "LOI") to acquire the "TJ Property" (the "Property").'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Fabled Copper Corp. ("Fabled Copper" or the "Company") (CSE:FABL)(FSE:XZ7) is pleased to announce that it has entered into letter of intent...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in the text as 'Mr. Peter J. Hawley, President and C.E.O.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is to 'acquire the "TJ Property"', which implies a 100% interest.

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project as having 'a gold, silver and base metal target' and notes 'high grade gold and silver mineralization'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article title 'Fabled Copper Enters into Letter of Intent to Acquire TJ Property...' directly relates to the acquisition of the TJ Ridge project.

currency.justification: Payments are denoted with '$'. The company is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange, as stated: '...as traded on the Canadian Securities Exchange...'. This context implies the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of two tranches: '1. $20,000 in cash to the Vendor on the date of execution of the Definitive Agreement (the "Effective Date"); 2. $50,000 in cash to the Vendor to twelve (12) months after the Effective Date'.

share_payments_raw.justification: A share payment is mentioned, but its value is contingent on a future third-party valuation, so no raw value can be extracted: 'a final payment... in common shares of Fabled, having a cash value equal to the value of the Property at such date, as determined by a third party valuator'.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are listed as separate components, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The number of shares to be issued is not specified and is dependent on a future valuation and the volume-weighted average price at that time.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any stock options.

issued_share_price.justification: The price per share for the transaction is not specified; it will be based on the '20 day Weighted Average Volume Price' at a future date.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention an exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The company must 'incur not less than $100,000 in exploration expenses on the Property prior to the date that is twenty four (24) months from the Effective Date'.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The vendor will be granted a royalty as part of the deal: 'Fabled will also grant the Vendor, or their nominee, a 2% NSR royalty over the Property'.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The TJ Property... consists of 6 contiguous mineral tenures covering an area of 3,176 hectares.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The TJ Property... consists of 6 contiguous mineral tenures covering an area of 3,176 hectares.

resource_size.justification: The text describes geochemical anomalies and sample results but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate (e.g., in tonnes or ounces).
